record.one_liner: Fathom records, transcribes and summarizes video meetings (Zoom, Meet, Teams) and exposes the meeting data via API, webhooks and MCP.
record.auth_notes: API key generated in User Settings > API Access, sent in X-Api-Key header; scoped to meetings the user recorded or that were shared with them/their team. OAuth2 for apps other Fathom users install; app registered via fathom.video/marketplace_applications/new; HTTPS redirect URIs; single-use refresh tokens. OAuth apps cannot use include_transcript/include_summary on /meetings and must use /recordings endpoints.
record.access_notes: FAQ says API keys and webhooks are included on all plans. I did not verify that a free plan specifically exists or is covered (inferred from "all plans"). OAuth app registration is self-serve (~2 min per docs); docs say OAuth apps are "subject to review" but tie it to marketplace visibility, and do not say whether review gates credential issuance.
record.blocker: API is narrow and mostly read-oriented (list meetings, meeting types, summary, transcript, download request, teams, users, create/delete webhook); cannot be assumed to start recordings. Rate limits are per account/key, and no increases are offered as standard. OAuth review/approval impact on production use is unclear.
